Standard: Covert position lights conform to SAE ARP5825, Covert Radiance Limits for Position Lights paragraph, SAE ARP5825, NRI Values for Covert Position Lights paragraph, SAE ARP5825, NRI Limits for Right Wingtip Covert Lights that are Supplemental to Position Lights that are not Installed on the Wingtip paragraph, and SAE ARP5825, NRI Limits for Left Wingtip Covert Lights that are Supplemental to Position lights that are not Installed on the Wingtip paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
(1) Ground test: Test installed covert position lights for conformance to SAE ARP5825, Covert Radiance Limits for Position Lights paragraph, SAE ARP5825, NRI Values for Covert Position Lights paragraph, SAE ARP5825, NRI Limits for Right Wingtip Covert Lights that are Supplemental to Position Lights that are not Installed on the Wingtip paragraph, and SAE ARP5825, NRI Limits for Left Wingtip Covert Lights that are Supplemental to Position lights that are not Installed on the Wingtip paragraph.
